quarantined_leads.lead: The Western District of Missouri charged Independence elementary-school substitute teacher Caleb J. Eyde by criminal complaint with distributing and possessing child sexual abuse material on August 24, 2026.

quarantined_leads.subject_response: No subject response was included in the DOJ release. The release states that the criminal-complaint charges are accusations, not evidence of guilt, and that Eyde is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
